sections.title: How weapons work
paragraphs: Lead designer Ez Jämsen describes Frostrail as guns-first rather than melee-first. Pistols, shotguns, rifles, and machine guns form the announced firearm families, with basic melee available earlier and a secondary melee action on ranged weapons.
Ammunition is framed as a valuable resource, so the official design messaging treats combat as a serious cost rather than an unlimited shooting gallery.
bullets: WWI-influenced firearm direction
Crafting is planned for all guns
Modular parts and weapon-modifying stations
No reliable public damage comparison yet

sections.title: Crafting & modifications
paragraphs: The developers say firearms are craftable and modular. In the official Assembly Station screenshot, the Bolt-Action Rifle uses interchangeable stocks and displays a concrete assembly requirement: slag metal ×5, wood ×3, and cloth ×2.
That screen lists Wooden, Padded, and Bare Bolt-Action Rifle Stock options. The selected Padded stock weighs 0.3 kg and shows +0.0% recoil and +0.0% stability in that captured build.

sections.title: Archived pre-alpha modular weapon screen
paragraphs: The 2025 official reveal trailer briefly shows an unnamed modular firearm with a prototype stat panel. The screen records damage, fire rate, clip size, spread, stagger, projectile, recoil, and stability values from that early build.

The same interface contains internal parameter labels and placeholder copy, so the weapon has not been assigned a public name here. These figures document Frostrail's development history; they are not current balance data and should not be used for weapon rankings.
sections.caption: Official 2025 reveal trailer frame; the interface is visibly labeled pre-alpha.

sections.title: Closed Beta: what can be verified now
paragraphs: Frostrail's Closed Beta is live through September 7, 2026. FakeFish permits recording and streaming, so a readable in-game weapon card can now support a build-specific entry. Until a card can be checked against its video or screenshot context, a weapon name, a player claim, or a tier-list ranking is not enough to establish a number.

sections.title: How current are these weapon stats?
paragraphs: The visible Bolt-Action Rifle values come from a newer official Assembly Station screen. The unnamed firearm values come from the older 2025 pre-alpha reveal and are kept separately. Both explain the weapon systems, but neither is a final balance promise.
bullets: Prototype weapon names are not invented
Current and archived screenshot values stay separate
New build values should replace older numbers, not sit beside them

sections.title: Inventory & resource management
paragraphs: Steam categorizes Frostrail around inventory and resource management. Recovered supplies must support both away-team equipment and the train's continuing operation.

The 2025 reveal trailer's pre-alpha interface shows five quick-access slots, a 5 × 5 personal storage grid, a displayed load of 3.2 / 100 kg, and a Metal Container with a 5 × 4 grid. It also shows example stacks of 14, 5, 4, 8, and 36, but the item icons are not labeled clearly enough to assign canonical names.
These are archived interface figures, not current balance promises. Current item weights, stack limits, rarity rules, vendor prices, and final slot counts still need a playable 2026 build.
bullets: Start with the item categories that affect a run
Keep every numeric value tied to the build that displayed it
Do not turn unlabeled icons into invented item names

sections.title: Closed Beta coverage
paragraphs: The April playtest included a tutorial, two exploration areas, weapon and essential-item crafting, and wildlife hunting for food. The currently live Closed Beta may show more than that early test, but its public announcement does not publish item cards, stack limits, recipes, or drop tables. Those fields remain open until they can be read from the game itself.

sections.title: What is still missing
paragraphs: A complete item list is not available yet. The old inventory values are retained only as an archived build snapshot; unlabeled icons are not turned into invented item names, and the current Closed Beta may use a different layout or carrying limit.

sections.title: Resource loop
paragraphs: The crew leaves the train to scavenge settlements, wreckage, ruins, bunkers, strongholds, and dungeons, then brings recovered materials back to onboard stations. Resources support weapons, equipment, repair, expansion, storage, heat, and motion.

Aku Jauhiainen gives one concrete production example: metal scraps are processed into slag metal and then pure metal. He says wood and plastic follow similar refinement logic, but does not publish every intermediate name or ratio.
bullets: Scavenge the frozen levels
Return materials to the train
Refine metal scraps → slag metal → pure metal
Use comparable refining systems for wood and plastic

sections.title: Documented material requirement
paragraphs: One current official Steam screenshot provides exact pre-release material quantities for assembling the pictured Bolt-Action Rifle: five slag metal, three wood, and two cloth. This should not be generalized to other guns or assumed final for Q4 2026 Early Access.

sections.title: Current Beta data boundary
paragraphs: The Closed Beta is live and players are allowed to record it, which makes new resource cards and station screens useful evidence when their build context is visible. The launch announcement does not publish refining ratios, fuel duration, carrying weight, stack size, or current station construction costs, so those numbers are not inferred from old footage.

sections.title: Confirmed crafting loop
paragraphs: Players scavenge materials in the frozen world, return to the train, and use onboard production facilities to strengthen both crew and locomotive. Weapons are planned to be craftable and modular rather than purely random drops.

The clearest published refinement example converts metal scraps into slag metal and then pure metal. The founder says wood and plastic are refined in similar ways, connecting raw salvage to higher-grade production inputs.

lore.eyebrow: The empire, the Void & the journey north
lore.title: World & Lore
lore.lede: Frostrail is set in a former empire entombed in frost after its Emperor made a pact with the Void. Players are Penitent Gardeners traveling north aboard the Eden Engine. Background lore exists, but FakeFish says survival systems—not story beats—are the gameplay driver.
lore.imageAlt: Official Frostrail key art of Penitent Gardeners beside the armored train

records.title: Penitent Gardeners

records.description: Official store copy: they purge the land of the cursed, grant mercy to the lost, and strike down the wicked while seeking salvation in the frozen desolation.

records.title: The Void
records.label: Cataclysmic force
records.description: The empire was twisted by the Emperor’s pact with the Void. Official copy does not define the Void as a faction, god, or location beyond that pact.

records.title: The Emperor
records.label: Historical figure
records.description: Named only as the ruler who made the pact that froze the empire. No biography, appearance, or in-game encounter is published.

sections.title: Official premise
paragraphs: Steam’s about text is the primary lore source: a mighty empire now lies barren under unrelenting cold; ruins are haunted by revenants and eldritch horrors; an armored steam train carries Penitent Gardeners seeking salvation.

Lead designer Ez Jämsen says there is a broader background narrative and lore, but story is not the gameplay driver. The tone is tension and action with light creepy aesthetics, closer to Barotrauma than a dedicated horror game.
bullets: Former empire frozen after a Void pact
Penitent Gardeners travel north
Revenants and eldritch horrors inhabit the ruins
Survival systems push the player, not a stated quest log

sections.title: Tone & influences
paragraphs: Jämsen would not call Frostrail a horror game. Horror elements stay light because the game is an action-based multiplayer title; the intended feeling is tension—something leaping from a dark corner or looming on the horizon. Founder Aku Jauhiainen has named Wolfenstein as a visual influence while stressing that Frostrail is more systems-heavy, in line with FakeFish’s Barotrauma DNA. Press coverage often compares the moving-base fantasy to Snowpiercer or Metro Exodus, but those comparisons do not establish a shared world or a direct creative link.

sections.title: The northward journey
paragraphs: The world is a sequence of levels. At the end of a level, the crew uses a tunnel to select the next route. Farther north, the world gets colder and harder. Everything happens in real time. Thorough exploration of points of interest can take two hours or more per level according to the founder interview; that is a development-time estimate, not a mission timer.
facts: Two hours or more — interview estimate

bolt-action-rifle.title: Bolt-Action Rifle

sections.title: Overview
paragraphs: FakeFish founder Aku Jauhiainen used the Bolt-Action Rifle to explain Frostrail's weapon progression and modular parts. The current official Steam gallery goes further: its Assembly Station screen names the rifle, shows a stock slot, lists three stock choices, displays assembly materials, and exposes the captured build's weapon statistics.
All values below are transcribed from that official image. They are authoritative evidence for the pictured pre-release build, but not guaranteed Early Access balance.

sections.title: Detailed stats
paragraphs: The official Assembly Station screenshot shows the following values. Negative percentages are preserved exactly as displayed; the image does not explain whether they are base penalties, assembled modifiers, or UI conventions.

sections.title: How to get
paragraphs: The screenshot confirms that this rifle can be assembled when its material requirements are met. It does not reveal when the recipe unlocks or whether the completed weapon can also spawn as loot, drop from enemies, or appear through a merchant.
facts: Later than the early-game Pipe Rifle — developer comparison

sections.title: Crafting recipe
paragraphs: The Assembly Station displays three material requirements for the pictured rifle. No craft time, station tier, blueprint requirement, output quality, or ammunition recipe is visible.

sections.title: Stock options & modifiers
paragraphs: The visible stock slot offers Wooden Bolt-Action Rifle Stock, Padded Bolt-Action Rifle Stock, and Bare Bolt-Action Rifle Stock. The selected Padded stock has the description “Gaudy and offering small false comforts to the Pilgrim judgment is rightly delivered.”
facts: Visible on model; names not readable

sections.title: Current Beta evidence
paragraphs: The Closed Beta is live through September 7 and permits recording and streaming. That makes a dated, readable in-game rifle card stronger evidence than a general discussion post or tier list. At the time of this review, no public Beta card has been independently matched to this official screenshot, so the displayed Assembly Station values remain the only verified set on this page.

sections.title: How to read these early stats
paragraphs: A single screenshot shows the displayed stats and recipe, but it cannot rank the rifle against every other gun or settle an optimal build. Ammo type, reload time, rarity, range, durability loss per shot, headshot multiplier, critical behavior, and stock comparison values have not been published.
bullets: Read 27.0 as the projectile damage shown in this pre-release build
Read 5 as clip size; the ammo type is not shown
Wait for a playable build before turning modifier percentages into timing or recoil advice
Check the page date when balance changes arrive
